title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced tape with fluctuating sound captures the high‑energy Summer Jam ’73, a massive crowd experience that shines despite imperfect recording.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered as an iconic, high‑energy festival moment with a sea of fans and a typical 1973 Dead vibe. The audience recording (aud) is uneven – it “fluxes” in places but offers moments of clear sound that let the fun and fine playing come through. Overall the show is enjoyable and underrated, though the audio quality prevents it from being a top‑tier listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between high praise for the show’s atmosphere and moderate criticism of the tape's variable sound; weighting show (70%) higher than recording (30%) yields a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: The audience tape fluctuates in level and clarity, with sections that sound pretty good but overall uneven fidelity typical of crowd recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical mid‑1973 set structure; the show flows well enough despite no specific song highlights noted.
